summary: Elme Communities (issuer) disclosed via Item 1.01 of Form 8-K that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Elme Bethesda Owner LLC (seller), entered into a purchase and sale agreement with CAPREIT Acquisition Corporation (buyer) to sell a 193-unit multifamily community in Bethesda, Maryland for $59.0 million. The transaction is subject to customary prorations and adjustments, with a $1 million earnest money deposit phased upon signing and expiration of an inspection period ending June 3, 2026. Closing is scheduled no later than the later of July 9, 2026 or 10 business days after obtaining a Montgomery County right-of-first-refusal compliance certificate. No financing contingency or advisor was disclosed. Investors should watch for successful completion of the inspection period and county approvals; risk-arb spread will depend on timeline and any unforeseen regulatory delays.
